warfarin.pharmacology: Inhibits vitamin K epoxide reductase (VKORC1), reducing synthesis of clotting factors II, VII, IX, X. Metabolized primarily by CYP2C9; narrow therapeutic index with high inter-patient variability (VKORC1/CYP2C9 genotype, diet, drug interactions).
warfarin.boxed_warning: Bleeding risk, which can be fatal. Regular INR monitoring required for all treated patients.
contraindications: Pregnancy (except select mechanical heart valve cases)
Recent major surgery with bleeding risk
